component.name: Hard Link Manager
component.summary: Manually deduplicate files on an SMB share by replacing near-duplicates with hard links

description.p: Hard Link Manager is a GUI desktop app for manually deduplicating files on an SMB share. Unlike tools that hash file contents to find exact duplicates, it lets the user manually select which files are "the same" (even when sizes differ slightly), pick a primary copy to keep, and replace the others with hard links to it.
